title: Berida kyun nazar aati zainab aaj abbas jo hote
body:
Berida kyun nazar aati zainab aaj abbas jo hote
moo na balon se chupati zainab aaj abbas jo hote
1. dulhane aun-o-mohammed ki le aati ghar me
byaha akbar ka rachati zainab aaj abbas jo hote
<<DIVIDER>>
2. shahzadi ki tarha apne watan mein rehti
khaid hokar nahi jati zainab aaj abbas jo hote
<<DIVIDER>>
3. roz shabbir ki masnat ko sajati ghar mein
farsh-e-matam na bichati zainab aaj abbas jo hote
<<DIVIDER>>
4. sar khule is ko toh suraj ne bhi dekha na yazid
kab tere samne aati zainab aaj abbas jo hote
<<DIVIDER>>
5. khwab kya kya nahin dekhe the sakina ke liye
uski turbat na banati zainab aaj abbas jo hote
<<DIVIDER>>
6. ya ali aayiye ab khud hi bachane ke liye
taziyane to na khati zainab aaj abbas jo hote
<<DIVIDER>>
7. ghar mein ayyi toh na pehchansake abdullah
kya zayifa nazar aati zainab aaj abbas jo hote
<<DIVIDER>>
8. kaha mo dhaap ke yeh asr ke suraj ne saroosh
be rida kyun nazar aati zainab aaj abbas jo hote
